title: The Catholic Monarchs
tagline: One crown, one faith, one empire stretching beyond the horizon.

scenes.text: Castile, 1474. Isabella inherits a kingdom in chaos — noble factions tearing at each other, Portugal threatening invasion. At twenty-three, she has already arranged her own marriage and declared herself Queen. The battle for Spain has not yet begun.

scenes.speaker: Isabel I of Castile
scenes.text: Ferdinand brings Aragon. I bring Castile. Together we bring unity — and unity brings everything else. The lords who resist us do not understand yet what it means to have a single crown.

challenge.instruction: The great lords of Castile will not bow to a queen of twenty-three. Beat them at their own game on the old Castilian board: form mills, take their pieces and leave them no line to hold.
challenge.fact: Isabel's claim to Castile was contested by her niece Juana, backed by Afonso V of Portugal and many of the great nobles. The War of the Castilian Succession turned at Toro in 1476 and ended with the Treaty of Alcáçovas in 1479.

scenes.text: She defeated Portugal at Toro in 1476. She reorganized royal finances. She established the Spanish Inquisition. She completed the Reconquista by taking Granada in 1492. And on that same year, she funded Christopher Columbus.

scenes.speaker: Christopher Columbus
scenes.text: Your Majesty, I ask only for ships, crew, and the right to keep one tenth of all riches found. The route to Asia — I am certain of it.

scenes.speaker: Isabel I of Castile
scenes.text: We have just finished one war and I will not be made a fool by a Genoese sailor. But neither will I let Portugal reach the Indies first. You have your ships.

challenge.instruction: Granada falls in January 1492, and the Alhambra is Isabel's. Set one queen in every glaze of its tilework — one per row, column and colour, and none touching.
challenge.fact: On 2 January 1492 Muhammad XII, the last Nasrid sultan, handed the keys of Granada to Isabel and Ferdinand, ending nearly eight centuries of Muslim rule in Iberia. That April, at Santa Fe outside the city, they signed the agreement that sent Columbus west.

scenes.text: The world Columbus reached was not Asia — but it belonged to Spain anyway, by Isabella's authority, backed by the Treaty of Tordesillas which literally divided the globe. Her gamble reshaped the world. Her will built a church and an empire simultaneously.

challenge.instruction: Queen Isabel must build a court coalition to fund Columbus's westward voyage. The treasury is drained — choose which concessions to grant so enough factions back the plan.
challenge.fact: The Capitulations of Santa Fe (1492) gave Columbus the title of Admiral and a share of profits. Isabel's gamble yielded the largest territorial windfall in European history.

challenge.instruction: Her captains have found a new world, and its riches are only beginning to reach Castile. Prepare the cacao drink of the peoples they met across the ocean.
challenge.fact: On his fourth voyage, in 1502, Columbus met a great Maya trading canoe off the island of Guanaja whose crew treasured cacao beans like money. Isabel died in 1504 without tasting chocolate; the drink reached the Spanish court decades later.

challenge.instruction: In Salamanca a chess book is printed for Isabel's son and heir. Follow the knight's path it sets — every square once, the numbered squares in order.
challenge.fact: Prince Juan, to whom Lucena dedicated his chess book, died in October 1497 at nineteen. The crowns of Castile and Aragon passed through his sister Juana to her son, the future Emperor Charles V.

scenes.speaker: Isabel I of Castile
scenes.text: Tenochtitlan is under Inquisition. At the end of every round, any side whose Belief totals under 5 is swept from the board. Batu Khan is already there and far too weak to last. Put me there and hold.

challenge.instruction: Fight lesson 4 · Survival. Deploy Isabel I of Castile to Tenochtitlan, keep at least 5 Belief there, and End Turn until two round endings have passed.
challenge.fact: A Local Survival event is a test, not a fight: at the end of each round every side at the location is checked, and a total under 5 loses every card there to the discard pile. Reinforce with followers, or retrieve a weak card before the round ends.
